chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ḥusayn ibn ʿUthmān, from Samāʿah, from Abī Baṣīr, who said:

If he forgets to recite in the first and second rakʿahs, the tasbih of the rukuʿ and sujud suffices for him. And if it is the morning prayer and he forgets to recite in it, then he should continue in his salat.

key_terms.يَقْرَأَ: to recite the required recitation in prayer

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if he forgets the recitation in the first two rakʿahs of salat?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling about one who forgets the recitation in salat, stating that the tasbih in rukuʿ and sujud is sufficient. It also clarifies that if this occurs in the morning prayer, the person should proceed with the prayer and not break it.
